bug_semantics: The authenticated workflow-controlled Edit Image Draw Text operation word-wraps its text parameter and passes the resulting string to gm.drawText(). gm 1.23.1 constructs a quoted GraphicsMagick MVG -draw argument and escapes double quotes, but it does not escape backslashes already supplied by the caller. An attacker can place a backslash immediately before a quote so gm's added backslash is itself escaped, closing the intended MVG text primitive and allowing a following attacker-selected MVG primitive to make a blind outbound request or open a local file.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable data flow is already present in the repository's parentless public root snapshot 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa: packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage.node.ts reads the text node parameter, builds renderText with lines.join('\n'), and sends it directly to gmInstance.drawText(), while packages/nodes-base/package.json declares gm ^1.23.1. That root is a 257-file, 42,436-line initial import rather than the smallest source commit, and no pre-root public commit/member history exists from which to identify the commit that actually authored the flawed mechanism.
ai_marker: unavailable: there is no valid smallest BIC commit object to inspect. The only public origin candidate, aggregate root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa, has commit-object author and committer Jan Oberhauser <jan.oberhauser@gmail.com>, message 'Initial commit to release', no trailers, and no AI marker; those aggregate-object identities cannot be attributed to the unavailable pre-public BIC.
evidence:
First-party advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-233r-fpgw-fx8x describes authenticated Draw Text MVG primitive injection causing blind SSRF/local-file access and gives structured affected boundaries <1.123.69, <2.33.4, and <2.34.1. Vulnerable-path history: `git log -L 1312,1344:packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts master` follows the still-unescaped lines through later formatting/refactor commits to root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa; `git log --all --reverse -S'.drawText(' -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage.node.ts packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` likewise returns only that root as the first addition. Root inspection: `git show --shortstat` reports 257 files and 42,436 insertions, `git cat-file commit 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa` has no parent header, and GitHub's commit API reports parents=[]; therefore there is no immediate parent tree against which the vulnerable lines can be checked and the aggregate cannot be decomposed to a smaller public member SHA. The root source reads `text`, computes `renderText = lines.join('
')`, and calls `.drawText(positionX, positionY, renderText)`; its package manifest uses gm ^1.23.1. Upstream gm 1.23.1 source at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aheckmann/gm/1.23.1/lib/drawing.js passes text through utils.escape(), and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aheckmann/gm/1.23.1/lib/utils.js shows escape() only replaces `"` with `"`, not existing backslashes. Fix: `git show ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` changes renderText to `lines.join('
').replaceAll('\', '\\')` and restricts fonts to the installed-font list. PR https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/35563 merged ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 from public head c4488a956f3d48e53c5aa3cc6a99c5851e8b2009; `git show -s --format='%H %T %P'` proves both commits have identical tree 77033e2954d683a27c8ea0c6e32d3c8566a95907 and parent a7dec6df87d2eaedffd22e7c8939804e350185a9. Branch backports are 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 (1.x), 0405fc550f55051f6c459252f5860fa78d27ab80 (2.33.x), and 170cfc787015d352488f6b6403af07a74e95ca1d (2.34.x). `git tag --contains` places them in n8n@1.123.69, n8n@2.33.4, and n8n@2.34.1 respectively; `git grep` at the boundaries shows plain `lines.join('
')` in n8n@1.123.68, n8n@2.33.3, and n8n@2.34.0, versus backslash-doubling in the three first patched tags.
reasoning: The advisory mechanism matches the source and dependency behavior: n8n treats workflow text as data, but gm serializes it into an MVG program and incompletely escapes the program-string boundary. Doubling caller-controlled backslashes before gm performs its quote escaping prevents a crafted backslash from neutralizing gm's escape; the installed-font allowlist closes the adjacent attacker-controlled font path. Line history and -S establish that every later edit before the fix preserved the vulnerable call and that the earliest public appearance is the root snapshot. However, the protocol forbids treating a squash/import aggregate as the BIC. The root has no parent and imports the whole initial codebase, so neither its 2019 object identity nor its absence of an AI trailer proves authorship of the unknown smaller source commit. The public fix and all three version boundaries are verified, but the origin-side public-history boundary prevents immediate-parent absence verification and a BIC-only AI judgment; BLOCKED is therefore required rather than NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The missing fact is the pre-public commit that first authored the Edit Image text-to-gm.drawText mechanism, together with that commit's immediate parent tree and commit object. Public n8n history starts at the parentless 42,436-line root import, and no member SHAs or earlier public repository were recoverable. That pre-root lineage is required to name the smallest BIC, verify vulnerable-line absence in its parent, and inspect AI evidence on the BIC itself.
